laws.rule: Minas Gerais IEF Ordinance 20/2025, article 25, prohibits campfires, camping outside designated areas and hiking outside existing trails in IEF-managed state conservation units. Article 29 excludes units under public-use ecotourism concessions, where the relevant concession contract applies; check the individual unit.

Minas Gerais IEF Ordinance 20/2025 prohibits drones and model aircraft without authorisation in covered state conservation units. Units under public-use ecotourism concessions are excluded from the ordinance; check their own rules.

Minas Gerais IEF Ordinance 20/2025 prohibits taking natural or mineral resources and bringing domestic animals into covered state conservation units, subject to specified authorised exceptions; guide dogs are allowed under applicable law. Units under public-use ecotourism concessions are excluded from the ordinance.

Minas Gerais IEF Ordinance 20/2025 requires authorisation for commercial use of images of covered state conservation units. Units under public-use ecotourism concessions are excluded from the ordinance and follow their own contracts.
